description: This file is a CMake configuration script for finding and setting up the Nexus library and related dependencies within a build system.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the nexus_config.h header file in specified PATH_SUFFIXES.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Searches for specified libraries: nexus, b_os, nexus_client, nxclient.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes auxiliary CMake modules, like FindPackageHandleStandardArgs.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard argument validation for package finding in CMake.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an imported library target for NEXUS::NEXUS.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Configures properties of CMake targets, including include directories and link libraries.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs status or error messages during CMake configuration.
